subject: Air freight quote DUS to BOM
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to BOM (Mumbai, IN)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-23, and we will deliver it to Düsseldorf Airport (DUS) ourselves.

The cargo is spare parts for packaging machines: 2 pieces, with a gross weight of 1676 kg and a total volume of 11.14 cbm.

Please send me your all-in price in EUR and let me know the earliest arrival you can offer.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
